sources.publication_clock: For a base award notice, publicationDate. For an amended row, use the later of publicationDate and amendmentDate so amended supplier/content fields are not backdated.
sources.coverage_rule: Exact reviewed foreign legal-entity aliases are scanned against supplierLegalName across the authoritative federal award-notice corpus from 2012-02-03 onward: legacy 2012-to-2022-08, an overlapping 2022-2023 bridge file, and the complete 2022-08-08-onward CanadaBuys file. Absence applies only to this exact-alias federal-award signal since 2012, not to procurement relationships under other legal names or outside this federal corpus.

sources.signal_definition: At least one federal CanadaBuys award-notice row on or after 2012-02-03 and before the event-time cutoff where supplierLegalName exactly normalizes to a reviewed foreign legal-entity alias.
